marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch.  Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# ChangeSpec name -> branch name conversion.
is_changespec = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_changespec:
        # ChangeSpec ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_file=$(mktemp /tmp/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff)
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

**What Phase 5 needed:** the runtime was writing names it could no longer classify. Two generation sites collaborate to produce them — resume/wait/retry naming appends `.f@`/`.w@`/`.r@` to a base that may already carry a `--<role>` suffix (`fi--code` → `fi--code.f0`), and family attachment then appends another role to that (`fi--code.f0--code`).

- `_resume.py` / `_retry.py` — resume, wait, and retry templates derive their base through that helper, so forking `foo--code` allocates `foo.f0`, not `foo--code.f0`.
- `_family_attach_resolution.py` — rejects a composed member (or renamed original-parent) name whose role suffix would not be terminal, with an error naming the parent, the role, and the name it would have written. Deriving a name silently was rejected here per the plan's "do not silently rename an agent the user explicitly asked for".
- `clan_membership.py` and `multi_prompt_launch_plan.py` — reject a clan name carrying a family marker, since members are `<clan>.<suffix>`.
- `agent_identity_facade.py` — exposes the core strict entry point as `validate_new_agent_name`.
- `tests/test_agent_generated_name_guard.py` — 23 tests covering the guard helpers, the three derived-name templates, attaching to a family-member parent, attaching to a clan-generation parent, the ordinary well-formed cases, the legacy-parent failure, and both clan paths.

It sits inside sase-91.2's in-progress area, so I left it rather than risk a conflicting edit.
- Two ACE PNG snapshots (`test_queued_clan_counts_png_snapshot`, `test_agent_lane_cleanup_confirmation_png_snapshot`) — unrelated, and that suite also showed a third intermittent failure on the clean tree.
